scope: Internal authoring rig for baking finished whole-character illustrated South walk cels. This contract does not authorize image calls, runtime puppet output, animation keys, in-betweens, or integration.

art_calls.opening_condition: Parent reviews this contract and issues a separate finite work order. Generate one original component per authorized call; stop on missing or materially wrong anatomy.

primary_south_reference.role: Sealed South canonical full-body appearance and neutral rest-shape authority. It is still a static identity candidate, not final art approval.

camera.source_fringe_warning: The sealed identity review retains a thin colored edge-fringe candidate warning; do not clean, crop, or normalize it as part authoring.

side_ownership.actor_left: Anatomical LEFT appears on viewer-right in the front-facing South reference. The asymmetric sash/knot remains on actor LEFT and viewer-right. Screen side does not establish depth.
side_ownership.actor_right: Anatomical RIGHT appears on viewer-left in the front-facing South reference. Screen side does not establish depth.
side_ownership.depth_semantics: LEFT/RIGHT name anatomical ownership only. Neither limb is permanently near or far. Neutral feet are modeled at the same depth; limb depth and occlusion order are resolved for each pose from model-space depth and actual overlap.
side_ownership.mirroring: Forbidden. Preserve the locked face, costume asymmetry, palette, lighting, and view.

component_policy.final_visual_method: Each authored pose is rendered and baked as a complete illustrated full-character PNG cel. Runtime consumes finished frames, never independently rotating component sprites.
component_policy.texture_handling: Retain each original RGBA component immutably with byte and decoded-RGBA hashes. No crop, alpha cleanup, tracing, repaint, anisotropic source-image calibration, or per-frame bounding-box rescaling.
component_policy.rest_pose: Use the sealed South neutral reference. Limbs are authored naturally unbent; do not pre-bend elbows or knees.
component_policy.calibration: For each original component, record one immutable measured uniform raw-to-rest scale/rotation/translation. Never anisotropically calibrate source textures. Model fixed-camera 3D depth foreshortening separately; it must not become per-frame bbox fitting or variable bone/model-plane length. Exact component calibration is pending originals.
component_policy.landmarks: Observed natural landmarks recorded after original inspection. Shoulder-only authored_cloth_attachment_convention permitted; hiddenhip pivots REQUIRE authored_hidden_hypothesis. All uncertainty is distinct from numerical mapping tolerance.
component_policy.projection: Keep the 2:1 dimetric camera fixed. Bone lengths remain constant in model space. Explicitly declared 3D camera-plane projection may foreshorten screen-space endpoint lengths by direction/depth; this is projection, not source-texture anisotropic calibration. No per-frame bounding-box rescaling.

parts.ownership: Hat, head, neck, full central torso/tunic, sash and its asymmetric knot/tail, pelvis, and tunic hem in one rigid illustrated core.
parts.rest_axis: Neutral South; head over torso and pelvis. No independent head, sash, or torso articulation in this minimal topology.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Paint sufficient hidden sleeve and thigh overlap beneath the core at all four attachment regions. Core masks close proximal seams. Preserve sash and hem silhouette; no holes at shoulders or hips.
parts.landmarks: Actual shoulder cloth attachment conventions ±14RAWpx; hips authored hidden hypotheses ±45RAWpx; exact rest mapping from one approved immutable static calibration. No measured shoulder/hip anatomical centers claimed.

parts.ownership: Actor RIGHT upper arm and sleeve, shoulder cap through elbow overlap.
parts.rest_axis: Shoulder to elbow in the natural neutral South view; exact axis and endpoints pending original-part measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Proximal cap extends beneath core mask; distal end overlaps actor RIGHT lower arm at elbow. Resolve whether the arm passes in front of or behind the core from model-space depth and actual overlap in each pose; do not fix its order by anatomical side.
parts.landmarks: Shoulder, elbow, and usable overlap bounds pending.

parts.ownership: Actor RIGHT forearm, cuff, wrist, and hand integrated into one illustrated component.
parts.rest_axis: Elbow to wrist/hand in neutral South view; exact axis and endpoints pending measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Overlap the upper-arm art at elbow and preserve a wrist semantic joint for counter-swing without separating the hand texture. No disembodied hand gap.
parts.landmarks: Elbow, wrist, hand center, and grip/attachment point if visible are pending.

parts.ownership: Actor LEFT upper arm and sleeve, shoulder cap through elbow overlap.
parts.rest_axis: Shoulder to elbow in the natural neutral South view; exact axis and endpoints pending original-part measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Proximal cap extends beneath core mask; distal end overlaps actor LEFT lower arm at elbow. Resolve shoulder occlusion from model-space depth and actual overlap in each pose. Preserve the asymmetric sash knot/tail on actor LEFT; do not relocate it.
parts.landmarks: Shoulder, elbow, and usable overlap bounds pending.

parts.ownership: Actor LEFT forearm, cuff, wrist, and hand integrated into one illustrated component.
parts.rest_axis: Elbow to wrist/hand in neutral South view; exact axis and endpoints pending measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Overlap the upper-arm art at elbow and preserve a wrist semantic joint for counter-swing with the hand attached. Protect actor-LEFT sash silhouette and avoid hand/body intersections in the baked pose.
parts.landmarks: Elbow, wrist, and hand center are pending.

parts.ownership: Actor RIGHT upper leg and trouser thigh from hidden hip overlap to knee overlap.
parts.rest_axis: Hip to knee in neutral South view; exact axis/endpoints pending original-part measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Top extends beneath the core hem mask. Distal end overlaps the corresponding lower leg at the knee. Resolve leg-crossing order from model-space depth and actual overlap for each pose.
parts.landmarks: Hidden hip is an authored hypothesis; visible thigh/knee bounds and uncertainty are pending.

parts.ownership: Actor RIGHT lower leg, shin wraps, ankle, foot, and sandal integrated as one illustrated texture.
parts.rest_axis: Knee to ankle in neutral South view. Include a semantic ankle/foot-plane sub-joint or authored shin/foot mesh regions so the sandal sole can hold contact while the shin rotates; exact boundary is pending actual art inspection.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Overlap upper leg at knee. Preserve heel, toe, and sole contact plane as a single rigid foot region during stance. Use controlled local deformation only at the authored mesh boundary; reject any setup that bends the sandal/sole or stretches bone lengths to force contact.
parts.landmarks: Knee, ankle, heel, toe, sole plane, and mesh boundary all pending actual original inspection.
parts.mesh_contract: The original component author must provide separate shin and foot/sandal mesh polygons with a shared ankle seam, plus independently inspected natural ankle, heel, toe, and sole-plane landmarks. The foot plane may remain planted while the shin rotates. If polygons or landmarks are absent or ambiguous, this part remains unresolved and the baker must refuse it; do not infer coordinates or rotate the entire texture as one rigid segment.

parts.ownership: Actor LEFT upper leg and trouser thigh from hidden hip overlap to knee overlap.
parts.rest_axis: Hip to knee in neutral South view; exact axis/endpoints pending original-part measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Top extends beneath the core hem mask. Resolve thigh and knee overlap from model-space depth for each pose; order may change as the legs cross.
parts.landmarks: Hidden hip is an authored hypothesis; visible thigh/knee bounds and uncertainty are pending.

parts.ownership: Actor LEFT lower leg, shin wraps, ankle, foot, and sandal integrated as one illustrated texture.
parts.rest_axis: Knee to ankle in neutral South view. Include a semantic ankle/foot-plane sub-joint or authored shin/foot mesh regions so the sandal sole can hold contact while the shin rotates; exact boundary is pending actual art inspection.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Overlap upper leg at knee. Preserve heel, toe, and sole contact plane as a single rigid foot region during stance. Permit actor LEFT to be the F0/F1/F2/F3 support track, then transfer support to actor RIGHT at F4; this contract does not authorize key creation.
parts.landmarks: Knee, ankle, heel, toe, sole plane, and mesh boundary all pending actual original inspection.
parts.mesh_contract: The original component author must provide separate shin and foot/sandal mesh polygons with a shared ankle seam, plus independently inspected natural ankle, heel, toe, and sole-plane landmarks. The foot plane may remain planted while the shin rotates. If polygons or landmarks are absent or ambiguous, this part remains unresolved and the baker must refuse it; do not infer coordinates or rotate the entire texture as one rigid segment.

pose_contract_reference.current_state: These are design constraints only. Existing F0 is a parent-selected candidate; F2 attempts are held. This preparation contract creates no selected rig pose, finished cel, or cycle approval.

depth_and_occlusion.rule: Resolve depth ordering independently for every pose using authored/model-space depth and the actual projected overlap. Do not assign permanent near/far status from viewer-left/viewer-right screen position or anatomical LEFT/RIGHT.
depth_and_occlusion.neutral_rest: The two feet are at the same model depth in the neutral rest pose unless direct measured source evidence and parent review establish otherwise.
depth_and_occlusion.joint_overlap: Use hidden authored overlap at shoulders, hips, elbows, and knees. Core masks close proximal seams. Determine which limb is in front at each overlap from that pose’s model depth; leg crossing may change order during the stride.
depth_and_occlusion.validation: The baker must reject missing or ambiguous depth/occlusion data rather than infer a permanent near/far assignment.

core_rest_adjustment.coverageRule: ONE immutable padded alpha-coverage domain, with no nonzeroalpha outside; original1254RGBA remains unchanged. This domain is not a scale/bbox fit.
